title: Swap Nodes in Pairs
description: Swap every two adjacent nodes in a singly linked list by adjusting pointers.

data.text: Given `head`, swap every two adjacent nodes and return the new head.

data.title: Value Swap O(n) O(1)
Pointer Rewire O(n) O(1)
What improved
data.text: Swapping values is easy but fails when the nodes carry extra payload or are part of another structure. Pointer-level swapping keeps the data untouched and truly exchanges node positions. A dummy head removes the awkward special case for swapping the very first pair.

cards.title: Swap Values
cards.description: Exchange Val fields between paired nodes
cons: Fails if nodes have complex state

cards.title: Swap Pointers
cards.description: Rewire Next pointers to exchange node order
